title: An own-save re-read after another device's erase shows the new record's values beside the old record's form until the erase's own remote signal applies
evidence: Owner ruling (2026-11-25, R13 PR 4 review), US-34 AC10: a read that has seen a later erase than the page shows writes the record read, as before, so the mirror never keeps the earlier record; the erase's own read then shows it. PR 4 added only the cases that write nothing: a read under an earlier erase than the one shown, and a store that moved during the read (useRecordApply signal, the values branch, eraseLater). Pin flipped: useRecordApply.test.tsx "US-34 AC4a (today, fix 4 owns erase events)" became "US-34 AC10 (H16)". Tests: useRecordApply.test, useRecordApply.erase.test, useRecordReads.test.
